edges.description: BAF-complex remodeling is also required for cardiac development; loss of SMARCC1 produces structural cardiac defects as an extra-neural arm of the syndrome.
Obstruction of the cerebral aqueduct impedes CSF flow, producing non-communicating hydrocephalus.
CSF outflow obstruction enlarges the cerebral ventricles.
Knockdown reproduces the aqueductal stenosis of the human structural brain malformation, with wild-type (but not variant) SMARCC1 rescue.
edges.limitations: Amphibian morpholino knockdown models acute gene depletion rather than a heterozygous human germline variant, and cannot reproduce the full human neurodevelopmental phenotype.

edges.description: The homozygous missense mouse reproduces the neural stem cell proliferation defect and apoptosis that underlie the human mechanism. Note this model's reduced proliferation is the opposite direction to the Baf155/Baf170 forebrain conditional knockout, which retains proliferation while blocking differentiation.
edges.limitations: The mouse carries a homozygous missense allele rather than the human heterozygous loss-of-function state, and its neural-tube phenotype is exencephaly rather than the hydrocephalus/aqueductal stenosis seen in patients, so the structural outcome is not directly reproduced.

nodes.description: Loss of BAF-complex remodeling impairs the H3K27 demethylases UTX/KDM6A and JMJD3/KDM6B, so repressive H3K27me3 marks accumulate at developmental genes. Established in Baf155/Baf170 conditional-knockout mouse forebrain rather than in the human heterozygous state.

evidence.snippet: BAF complexes globally control the key heterochromatin marks, H3K27me2 and -3, by directly modulating the enzymatic activity of the H3K27 demethylases, Utx and Jmjd3

nodes.description: Dysregulated transcription impairs neuronal differentiation and neurogenic output of neural progenitors in the developing telencephalon, the proposed neural-stem-cell basis of SMARCC1-associated congenital hydrocephalus. The two mouse models disagree on the direction of the proliferation change: the Baf155/Baf170 forebrain conditional knockout keeps progenitors proliferating while blocking differentiation (PMID:29779894), whereas the Baf155msp/msp missense mouse shows reduced progenitor proliferation (PMID:33077954). Only the shared impaired-differentiation/neurogenesis outcome is asserted here; the proliferation direction is left unbound.

nodes.description: Ventricular shunting (ventriculoperitoneal shunt) or endoscopic third ventriculostomy to decompress ventriculomegaly/hydrocephalus, the latter particularly for the obstructive aqueductal-stenosis physiology. It can acutely reduce ventricular size, but carries high morbidity and failure rates and, in developmental (primary) congenital hydrocephalus, may fail to reduce ventriculomegaly or improve neurodevelopmental outcomes.
